author: Ryan Martinolich
title: Sheriff: Jacksonville man arrested after investigation into domestic violence - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Martinolich ,
1 days ago
ONSLOW COUNTY, N.C. (WNCT) -- The Onslow County Sheriff's Office said they arrested a man after an investigation into reported incidents of domestic violence.
Authorities said that in May, the United States Marine Corps Provost Marshal's Office responded to a reported domestic disturbance involving Joshua Lanman, 24, and the victim aboard the MCAS New River.
According to the Onslow County Sheriff's Office, detectives with the sheriff's office were notified and an investigation began with the assistance of the Marine Corps Provost Marshal's Office.
Detective said that during the investigation, it was determined that Lanman committed acts of domestic violence against the victim, including strangulation, dating back several years in the Sneads Ferry area.
Lanman was arrested on August 28 and charged with the following offenses:
Felony Assault by Strangulation Misdemeanor Crime of Domestic Violence Misdemeanor Assault on a Female Lanman was placed on a $20,000 unsecured bond with electronic ankle monitoring.
